topic.source_contract: Local Nature Recovery Strategy planning and delivery evidence

facts.lnrs_role: public authorities and plan-makers have regard to relevant LNRS
facts.guard: strategy evidence is not permission or completed habitat delivery
statutory guidance is not a candidate-specific overlay

facts.coverage: England with no gaps or overlaps
facts.guard: area publication status is not delivery evidence
proposed actions are not binding land-use permissions
strategic expectations are not site decisions

scope_guards: LNRS priorities and mapped proposals are not planning permissions or HMLR title boundaries.
Publication of a strategy does not prove funding, landowner agreement or delivery.
Local habitat maps and biodiversity-priority statements remain distinct evidence components.
Candidate use requires the correct local strategy and current version.
The duty to have regard is not a duty to approve or refuse a development.
Nature-recovery opportunity mapping is not an ecological survey or statutory-designation boundary.
Greater London publication status is not proof of an exact parcel intersection.
No score or promotion is written without exact current LNRS mapping, site geometry, ecological and planning evidence.
